problem: ARIES could drive applications and files but knew nothing about services, disks, packages, connectivity or pixels, could not put text anywhere, and — the gap the user named directly — could not say what it was able to do. A person who has to guess at an assistant's abilities concludes it is broken.
change: Five agents in parallel, each confined to one new file so they could not collide; every shared-file edit (registry.py, capabilities.py) applied serially by the coordinator afterwards. Added screen_capabilities (portal screenshot plus tesseract OCR by ctypes into a snap library), system_capabilities (systemd units, disk, packages), network_capabilities (connectivity, wifi, brightness), input_capabilities (clipboard and AT-SPI typing) and introspection (self-knowledge). Spoken capabilities 37 to 54, typed registry capabilities 41 to 58. introspection.py derives every list at call time from CATALOGUE, ARGUMENTS, SENSITIVE and the registry rather than from a written list, so it cannot drift; a capability nobody grouped appears as ungrouped instead of vanishing, which is how the two new self-knowledge capabilities were caught.
validation: Per-module suites all green: network 94 checks, system 78, screen 55, input 62, speech 46. After each registration the catalogue contract held ({catalogue ids} == set(ARGUMENTS)), every catalogue example parsed, and the dangerous regressions were re-checked by hand each time: start Firefox still open_app, install firefox still install_app, read file still read_file, pause still media_control, volume 30 still set_volume. Full ./scripts/test.sh ALL SUITES PASSED after three of the four registrations; after the last two changes seven targeted suites were run (workspace, speech, operator, ui_contract, api, workspace_recovery, security), all green. introspection.report() live: 54 spoken, 58 typed, 9 gated, 7 limits, 6 of 6 subsystems ready, nothing ungrouped. The network module was independently audited by AST walk rather than trusted: the complete command set is 12 read-only nmcli/ip/iw/busctl queries plus exactly one write, nmcli connection up uuid; no shell=True, no monitor mode, no packet capture, no passphrase handling.
limitations: Agents caused real side effects while probing and all were reported to the user: chrony.service was restarted once and a polkit dialog raised; screen gamma was changed and restored to a 1025-entry identity ramp instead of 1024 (verified linear, no visible effect) with the byte-exact restore denied by the permission system and deliberately NOT performed on the agent's behalf; roughly 15-20 screenshots flashed on screen during validation; the clipboard was read and byte-identically restored. Unverified: HiDPI and multi-monitor screen scaling, type_text against Firefox/VS Code/LibreOffice, the dashboard approval round trip for service_control, system-scope service control (cannot work unprivileged and no path that tries was shipped), and the logind SetBrightness write path (no backlight device exists here to aim it at). The full suite has not been run since the last two changes.
